title: UAAP: La Salle shows poise, pulls away late to outlast rival Ateneo
summary: De La Salle University displayed poise to outlast rival Ateneo de Manila University, 83-76, in UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball on Wednesday at the Mall of Asia Arena in Pasay.
